name: esqhv8-hub-message-session
goal: A Hub Home chat box delivers Daniel's message into the Chief of Staff pane, and each session's Message button into that exact live run's pane, over the linked-computer connection with the Mac Home upload off; receipts show stored, delivered and acknowledged, and the session's tracker reply appears in the Hub thread, on desktop and phone width

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Today Message buttons only open the Agents dialog; the composer writes a 'Hub message:' NOTE (POST /api/hub-home/chat, refused on prod with the upload off) and nothing types it into a session; 'sent' means a note was stored and replies are guessed from the last 5 notes. Expected: CoS chat box + per-session Message deliver into the cos pane / that exact live run pane via TrackerTmuxAdapter, never another run, with receipts stored/delivered/acknowledged and a keyed tracker reply shown in the Hub thread. Repro: hub-home e2e with a linked Mac (no upload) sending a CoS message; tracker unit with a fake cos pane.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: No test covered message delivery at all: hub-home specs fake POST /api/hub-home/chat and assert only 'Sent to Tracker'; tracker tests cover nudges for digests/handoffs but no Hub message path, receipt or reply. Gap: no fixture models a message's lifecycle (stored -> pane -> reply). Reusable change: hubSessionMessages note format + fold (tested), a local API /messages test, a delivery test with a fake watchdog port, and the linked-computers fixture answering homeChat kind 'message' and serving threads in homeSnapshot.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red at 34e6d329c9 (test-only commit): the unit command (root hub-session-messages, tracker-hub-messages, tracker-reply + hub hub-home-messages) failed with 'Failed to load url' for the missing hubSessionMessages/trackerHubMessages modules; assertions unchanged afterwards. Hub e2e red at the same commit recorded separately.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
